prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a replacement full-bleed photographic hero background for the After Bells perfume collection web page. Very wide landscape, approximately 12:5 aspect ratio (2400 by 1000).
Input image 1: product design reference and existing composition; preserve the exact three glass perfume bottles, ornate square engraved gold caps, front gold labels, liquid colors, and tiny naturally settled gold leaf flecks. Replace the anonymous studio setting with an evocative photographic story.
Story: After Bells is the pause when the city quiets after the bells. Amber Hour is the warmth of dusk on stone steps, Open Sky the first clean breath through an open window, Iron Crown the depth of midnight and a trace of frankincense.
Scene: intimate view from inside a shadowed old limestone loggia, looking past three perfumes resting on a real timeworn stone windowsill toward a distant old city and a modest bell tower at blue hour. The bells have just fallen silent; a few tiny windows have lit up. A thin ivory linen curtain stirs in the open air at the far right. A delicate, almost invisible wisp of incense at the right catches the last light. Natural amber sunset kisses the glass and stone, outside sky is softly desaturated blue, deep espresso interior shadows. This should feel like a remembered evening in a real place, with tactile worn limestone, imperfect linen, still air and emotional quiet, photographed on medium format with subtle film grain. Editorial luxury, restrained, cinematic photorealism.
Composition: preserve generous DARK AND QUIET negative space across the left 45% and top left for HTML title, body copy and navigation. Scene and subjects entirely in right 55%. The three bottles are on one continuous weathered windowsill, at slightly different depths, all fully visible including caps and bases, label faces toward camera. Amber Hour at x60%, Open Sky x74%, Iron Crown x87%. Bottles occupy middle-to-lower right, their cap tops around 30% of image height and glass bases around 85%; their size is close to the provided original but a little more environmental. Bell tower is small and softly focused in the upper right background between bottles. No large architectural objects obscuring bottles. Stone below has photographic surface variation rather than staged geometric podiums. Keep bottle scale plausible, match sunset reflections to the new setting.
Exact product label text, each on separate bottles: "AFTER BELLS" / "AMBER HOUR"; "AFTER BELLS" / "OPEN SKY"; "AFTER BELLS" / "IRON CROWN".
Avoid: studio cyclorama, display podiums, floating products, fantasy architecture, excessive orange, decorative sparkles, giant gold flakes, ingredient piles, additional bottles, people, collages, text overlays, headings, frames, UI, watermarks. No lettering anywhere except the existing bottle labels.
